name: KLIK Disposable | Electric Lemon
description: Energize your senses with our Electric Lemon . This vibrant flavor features a zesty, tangy lemon with an electrifying burst of citrus freshness. Each puff delivers a crisp, invigorating taste that’s both uplifting and refreshing, perfect for adding a zesty zing to your day while enjoying a smooth, satisfying experience.
